name: job-assistant
description: Prepares and tracks job applications from a career profile the person owns: every source is accounted for, every extracted claim is confirmed or excluded before it can be used, and every generated statement cites a confirmed claim ID.

notes: Initial package: onboarding-by-accounting, claim extraction and matching, resume and cover letter drafting with claim citations, job capture, and the browser bridge envelopes.

The eve adapter (adapters/eve/) mounts the package's skills and its content-is-data instruction fragment into the runner's agent, declaring no tools of its own since job actions run as runner tools and bridge events instead.
